purpose: Revalidate frozen LAW5, LAW6 and LAW8 without tuning on a previously unused backward holdout year.

frozen_laws.LAW1: Apply frozen V2 race pick MODEL_TOP15 + rank_upgrade>=5 + max1, then keep rank_upgrade 15-24 and field_size 15-16.
frozen_laws.LAW2: GAP10P with model_rank_band=1-3, max1/race using frozen candidate sort.
frozen_laws.LAW5: GAP7_9 with field_size_band=15-16 and model_rank_band=9-10, max1/race using frozen candidate sort.
frozen_laws.LAW6: GAP7_9 with market_rank_band=11-15 and l17_rank_band=21-30, max1/race using frozen candidate sort.
frozen_laws.LAW8: GAP5P with field_size_band=<=12 and l17_rank_band=21-30, max1/race using frozen candidate sort.

required_outputs: largest-win share and ROI after removing largest 1 and largest 2 wins
